headline: Salman Shah murder case: Accused 'Don' arrested at Dhaka airport
summary: Mohammad Ashraful Haque, known as Don, was detained while attempting to travel to Saudi Arabia for Umrah.
details: Immigration police arrested Mohammad Ashraful Haque, widely known as Don, at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka today.
Ashraful was detained at the airport and subsequently handed over to the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) for further investigation.
The arrest occurred around 6:00 am today as Ashraful was attempting to travel to Saudi Arabia to perform Umrah.
CID officials had previously issued a requisition to airport authorities and a court directive to prevent the accused named in the FIR from leaving the country.
Following his arrest, Dhaka Metropolitan Magistrate Md Jewel Rana sent the accused to jail after police produced him before the court.
The case dates back to September 6, 1996, when actor Salman Shah, then 25, was found dead at his Eskaton Road residence in Dhaka.
Salman Shah, born Shahriar Chowdhury Emon, was one of the most popular film stars of the 1990s.
caption:
A major breakthrough in a decades-old case: 'Don' is arrested at the airport while trying to leave the country.

Immigration police arrested Mohammad Ashraful Haque, widely known as Don, at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka today.

Ashraful was detained at the airport and subsequently handed over to the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) for further investigation.

The arrest occurred around 6:00 am today as Ashraful was attempting to travel to Saudi Arabia to perform Umrah.

CID officials had previously issued a requisition to airport authorities and a court directive to prevent the accused named in the FIR from leaving the country.

Following his arrest, Dhaka Metropolitan Magistrate Md Jewel Rana sent the accused to jail after police produced him before the court.

The case dates back to September 6, 1996, when actor Salman Shah, then 25, was found dead at his Eskaton Road residence in Dhaka.

Salman Shah, born Shahriar Chowdhury Emon, was one of the most popular film stars of the 1990s.
